attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado military retirement exemption (2025). Age-based: Under 55 = $15k, 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, Colorado DOR.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize CO military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "CO Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_under_55 min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age < 55): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_55_to_64 min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age 55-64): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_65_plus min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age 65+): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No CO military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
